description: This file contains unit tests for the DirectoryMembershipSnapshot functionality in an Orleans-based distributed system, focusing on range ownership, ring coverage, and non-intersecting member ranges.

classes.name: DirectoryMembershipSnapshotTests
classes.description: A test class containing unit tests for directory membership snapshot functionality, including range ownership, ring coverage, and non-intersecting ranges.

methods.name: GetOwnerTest
methods.description: Tests that the TryGetOwner method correctly identifies ownership when the cluster has members.

methods.name: MembersDoNotIntersectTest
methods.description: Ensures that the ranges assigned to different members do not intersect.

methods.name: ViewCoversRingTest
methods.description: Verifies that the union of all member ranges covers the entire ring.

methods.name: MemberRangesCoverRingTest
methods.description: Checks that the combined ranges of all members cover the entire ring, similar to the previous test.
